description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case for the LDAPSetting data transfer object (DTO) used in LDAP authentication within the OrangeHRM system. It defines a test class 'LDAPSettingTest' with a test method 'testFromString' that verifies the creation and string representation of LDAPSetting instances and exception handling for invalid input.

classes.name: LDAPSettingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the LDAPSetting DTO, focusing on object creation, serialization, and input validation.

methods.name: testFromString
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of LDAPSetting with valid parameters, checks its string representation, and verifies that invalid encryption options throw an InvalidArgumentException.
